modelingNotes: The OSM plan spans the full former cattle hall. Its 16 m outline and mapped 17/19 m raised roof parts define the roof hierarchy.

The selected exterior photograph shows a long open iron-and-glass elevation, regular columns and a central raised clerestory. Truss spacing and glazing bay dimensions are simplified map-scale readings.
Ground-floor glazing is represented by wall-attached opaque panels. Interior stalls, small metal lattice members and later event fittings are omitted.
